behavioral_effects: governance sample verifies manifest claims about seeded-random application files: layering imports, repository commit discipline, the utcnow ban, and settings references known to the configuration manifest
First full census (count 162, the whole pool): 160 of 162 files agree with the map
compatibility_impact: None - new read-only command; no existing behavior changed
follow_up: Fix the two census findings (task spawned), then re-run governance sample --count 162 expecting zero mismatches
Consider a scheduled CI job running sample at default count with a rotating seed once the two findings are fixed
limitations: FINDING (latent runtime bug): backend/app/services/sync_source.py references settings.CHANNEL_ENCRYPTION_KEY, which no Settings field, computed property, or env template defines - the encrypt/decrypt paths raise AttributeError if reached; spawned as a follow-up task
FINDING (invariant violation): backend/app/services/agent_session.py lines 464 and 523 call datetime.utcnow() against the declared datetime.now(UTC) invariant; same follow-up task
The sampler checks only mechanically-verifiable claims; curated purpose and intent text remain review-trusted until blueprint phase 6
reason: Until the blueprint phase-6 AST graph exists, nothing verifies that the curated claims agents are briefed with match the code they describe; a wrong claim would mislead every session that trusts it. A seeded random sample verifying the mechanically-checkable claims - layering imports, repository commit discipline, utcnow ban, settings references known to the configuration manifest - bounds that staleness cheaply. Plan Phase 6 item 6, adopted proactively as the only fidelity check available before the graph
rollback: git revert removes the command, scanner, and tests
security_impact: None for the tool itself - read-only AST parsing, never imports application modules. The first census surfaced a security-adjacent finding recorded below
summary: governance sample: map-vs-territory spot checks on random tracked files

validators_run.evidence_ref: 118 tests - scanner unit tests (imports, commits, utcnow, uppercase settings refs, syntax-error-as-unknown), seeded reproducibility on the real repository, toplevel guard
